<thought>Using the mapped reaction for template 74054, the product is formed from two reactants: (1) an acetyl‑phenol bearing a nitro group and (2) cyclobutanone. Removing the atom‑mapping gives the SMILES of the precursors as “O=C(C)c1c(O)ccc(N(=O)=O)c1” and “O=C1CCC1”. These are the only possible precursor pair for the given product.</thought>
<final_answer>[[\"O=C(C)c1c(O)ccc(N(=O)=O)c1\", \"O=C1CCC1\"]]</final_answer>
